# SetEnv <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetEnv:Void env_var:String, value:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env_var` | In | String | required | The name of the variable. |
| `value` | In | String | required | The new value. |

## Description

Sets an environment variable for this program and for the programs it starts with [ExecFile](ExecFile). It is not changed for the rest of the system.
